semantic.justification: Represented RTF paragraph and character items use upstream-shaped attribute output; complete source parity remains unverified. Native WriteNativeCharacter now delegates original associated-group ordering rather than emitting only Western fonts. Basic underline keywords move to the source association stage while non-associated underline color remains before it. All three native language values are emitted in their original families. Source caller collection uses a temporary actual set without mutating the borrowed input; native run script/bidi production and full paragraph-marker/general-property owners remain open. Native non-associated OutputCharFontAssoc updates the actual RtfExport current encoding through FontMapExport and checked font charset selection, with original unknown-to-default fallback; associated font output leaves encoding unchanged. Native RunText ignores its supplied charset and delegates RawText/OutString using current export encoding. RTF text uses represented GetSnippet substitutions; style names and hyperlink values use OutString. FontFamilyType, FontPitchType, FontCharset, StartFont, FontAlternateName and EndFont write to the actual export SvStream. Associated font controls now borrow the complete SvxFontItem rather than only its name. S3HW1E RTF numbering-table integration: actual GetNumberingId pointer identity and the InitFontTable used-rule snapshot replace the separate name-keyed RTF list map. Original abstract/instance loops emit nine Word levels or one continuous level, including the actual outline owner. Source level preparation preserves ListFormat UTF16 placeholders, separator suppression, unsupported level10 handling, unsigned-byte positions and signed16 geometry; RtfAttributeOutput writes original NFC/CJK-language, alignment, start, legal, follow, font/character properties and destinations. The browser command-rule assembler now supplies level-specific ListFormat instead of creating deprecated patternless numeric levels. Original character color/underline visitors run before header serialization to admit numbering-style colors; native accumulated automatic-style vector order and shared-handle release are preserved. New owned item sets are disposed. WRITER198 records retained adjacent separators. Common numbering preparation is currently bound to the actual RTF virtual output; full common AttributeOutputBase/DOCX numbering, graphic brush ownership, paragraph numbering/restart temporary-rule lifetimes, character-style table/cache and complete OutColorTable responsibilities remain unverified. This source-bound focused integration does not certify full upstream parity or filter completeness. S3HW1E Word style/cache integration: MSWordStyles now consumes the actual MSWordExportBase, appends non-default character formats before non-reserved paragraph formats and keeps source4091 limits, reserved heading slots, character self-next, identity lookup and builtin-first ASCII name disambiguation across both families. Native GetWWId and all91 original English names replace the partial paragraph-name map; consumed paragraph pool enum identities are admitted from the pinned header. Actual concrete exporters implement the native ExportFormat virtual. MSWordExportBase character GetId uses the actual initialized style table. Source GetSlot(null) selects the first empty reserved entry (WRITER201), not an invented missing sentinel. RTF style framing/colors/buffer flushing use native StartStyles/StartStyle/EndStyle/EndStyles, and InsStyle/GetStyle keep first-inserted property-only entries. Existing StyleDefinition string sinks bind EndStyle with explicit drained properties; full native OutputFormat/item-buffer contracts remain unverified. Full typed SwFormat auto-update state is not admitted; document export passes its represented native defaultfalse. The current core lacks native hidden default paragraph collection0, so the existing Standard-first logical paragraph table binding is retained and not certified as source ownership equivalence. Footnote materialization, list-style true branch, linked style graph, full OutColorTable collectors, character style importer and paragraph numbering dispatcher/restart integration remain explicit obligations. Unchanged compiled native style helpers plus original enums/operators match all65536 pool IDs,91 names and null slots1/10 under ASan/UBSan, with a scalar SwFormat/vector-entry carrier only; this is not complete Writer/style ABI or whole-module certification.
